lead.headline: Treasury buyback triggers $4B crypto short squeeze as regulatory clarity builds in Washington
lead.tldr: A surprise US Treasury bond buyback liquidated billions in bearish crypto bets and pushed Bitcoin past $77,000, while the SEC's 'Reg Crypto' framework and Oval Office engagement signal the most consequential regulatory momentum since the industry's founding.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week the market learned that Treasury operations can move crypto faster than Fed speeches, and founders learned that Washington's regulatory fog may finally be lifting.

top_signals.title: Harmony plans pre-attack rollback after exploiter forged 3 trillion ONE tokens
top_signals.summary: Harmony is planning a network rollback to recover from a massive exploit where an attacker forged 3 trillion ONE tokens. The protocol determined that a rollback is the most secure and fair method of recovery compared to token burns or wallet blacklisting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Harmony's rollback decision reveals the governance bankruptcy of smaller L1s: when 'decentralized' networks face existential exploit, the only credible recovery mechanism replicates tradfi circuit breakers, destroying the very settlement finality that justifies token value.

top_signals.title: Traders bet bitcoin was stuck below $67,000. The Treasury blew that trade up in one afternoon
top_signals.summary: A surprise bond buyback by the US Treasury triggered a massive short squeeze in the crypto market. This event liquidated over $4 billion in bearish bets and propelled Bitcoin's price above $77,000.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Treasury buyback episode demonstrates that crypto's correlation to macro liquidity is now so tight that sovereign debt management operations, not crypto-native catalysts, drive the largest price moves and liquidation cascades.

top_signals.title: Weekly Research Brief: SEC Unveils Long-Awaited ‘Reg Crypto’
top_signals.summary: The SEC has unveiled its long-awaited 'Reg Crypto' framework, marking a major regulatory milestone for the industry. Additionally, the brief covers Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter and Centrifuge's consideration of converting tokens to stock.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The SEC's framework release, combined with Stripe's OpenRouter acquisition and Centrifuge's token-to-equity exploration, marks the first coherent signal that regulators and sophisticated corporates are converging on how to price and structure crypto assets within existing securities architecture.

top_signals.title: View latest issue, $1B Short Squeeze Rockets BTC
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin experienced a significant price surge driven by a $1 billion short squeeze. This event forced short sellers to close their positions, further accelerating the upward price momentum.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $1B short squeeze confirms that derivatives-market positioning has become the dominant price-discovery mechanism, making Bitcoin susceptible to reflexive melt-ups that detach from any underlying demand or adoption metric.

top_signals.title: Inside the Oval Office meeting: Trump appears ‘bullish’ on Clarity Act as he solicits feedback from crypto, finance CEOs
top_signals.summary: President Trump held a private Oval Office meeting with crypto and finance CEOs to solicit feedback on the Clarity Act. Sources indicate the President appears bullish on the passage of the legislation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Presidential engagement on the Clarity Act, however performative, shifts the probability distribution on US regulatory clarity sufficiently that institutional capital formation should reprice the cost of legal ambiguity in American crypto markets.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin hits $69,000, ether jumps 10% as Treasury buybacks, SEC crypto proposal fuel market rally
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced a significant price rally, with Bitcoin reaching $69,000 and Ether jumping 10%. The surge was driven by Treasury buybacks and a new SEC crypto proposal, resulting in nearly $2 billion in liquidations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The nearly $2B in liquidations during a Treasury-and-SEC-driven rally reveals a market structurally long volatility but short conviction, where leveraged positioning amplifies macro catalysts into discontinuous price jumps.

deals.summary: Ripple has successfully raised $275 million through a senior note offering to expand its US operations. The funds will be used to develop institutional financial services, specifically focusing on prime brokerage and multi-asset clearing.

QuantumLight, a venture capital firm co-founded by Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky, has successfully closed its second fund. The fund has raised a total of $500 million to support its investment activities.

MicroStrategy raised approximately $333.7 million through the sale of 3.46 million shares. Unlike previous equity raises, the proceeds were used for dividends, share repurchases, and USD reserves rather than purchasing additional Bitcoin.

Ark Invest has increased its holdings in Block Inc by purchasing $15 million in shares during a price dip. Additionally, the firm acquired $1 million in shares of Securitize following a significant drop in the company's valuation.

on_the_radar.title: StanChart, HSBC execute first live transaction on Swift blockchain ledger
on_the_radar.summary: Standard Chartered and HSBC have successfully executed the first live cross-border transaction using Swift's blockchain ledger. This milestone marks a significant step in the expansion of tokenized deposit infrastructure among global systemic banks.

on_the_radar.title: SEC proposes new crypto offering rules as Congress stalls on digital asset legislation
on_the_radar.summary: The SEC has proposed a new rule intended to create a formal pathway for investments involving digital assets. This move comes amid a legislative stalemate in Congress regarding digital asset regulation.

on_the_radar.title: Securitize brings Neuberger’s $230 billion fixed-income platform onchain with new tokenized fund
on_the_radar.summary: Securitize is bringing Neuberger Berman's $230 billion fixed-income platform onchain through a new tokenized fund. The HINC fund will be deployed across multiple major blockchains including Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, and Sui.

on_the_radar.title: Citi expects to launch bitcoin custody later this year under its new Custody+ platform
on_the_radar.summary: Citi plans to launch Bitcoin custody services later this year as part of its new Custody+ platform. The platform will integrate AI-powered market intelligence, instant settlements, and liquidity tools.

on_the_radar.title: Zcash hits eight-year high near $850 with futures volume near $10 billion amid Grayscale ETF push
on_the_radar.summary: Zcash has reached an eight-year price peak near $850, driven by significant futures trading volume and a push for a Grayscale ETF. Market data shows nearly $10 billion in 24-hour futures volume, indicating high derivative activity.

on_the_radar.title: BounceBit to sunset blockchain, migrate to BNB Chain after $3 million exploit
on_the_radar.summary: BounceBit is sunsetting its own blockchain and migrating to the BNB Chain following a security exploit. The attacker managed to transfer approximately 286.5 million BB tokens before block production was halted.

on_the_radar.title: Laser Digital gets Japan’s first crypto exchange approval in 4 years46m
on_the_radar.summary: Laser Digital has received approval to operate as a crypto exchange in Japan, marking the first such license granted in the country in four years. This move signals a potential opening of the Japanese market to new institutional digital asset services.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin surge toward $80K points to liquidity-driven momentum shift as ETF flows rebound: Bernstein
on_the_radar.summary: Bernstein reports that Bitcoin's surge toward $80,000 is driven by a shift in liquidity momentum and rebounding ETF flows. The analysis notes that MicroStrategy's holdings have returned to a profitable position relative to their average purchase price.

on_the_radar.title: South Korea's Shinhan partners with Solana Foundation, Etherfuse, Orca for tokenized fund issuance
on_the_radar.summary: South Korean financial giant Shinhan is partnering with the Solana Foundation, Etherfuse, and Orca to explore tokenized fund issuance. The collaboration involves a proof-of-concept for the distribution of a fund denominated in Korean won.

on_the_radar.title: MANTRA freezes all transactions and network following unspecified incident
on_the_radar.summary: MANTRA Chain has frozen all network transactions and halted operations following the discovery of an unspecified incident. The nature of the event has not yet been disclosed by the team.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
on_the_radar.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig stated that the agency will independently pursue crypto regulation if Congress fails to pass the CLARITY Act. This indicates a move toward regulatory certainty regardless of legislative outcomes.

on_the_radar.title: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming a 'full bank' outside the US
on_the_radar.summary: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is exploring the possibility of obtaining a full banking license outside of the United States. The company aims to expand its service offerings to include lending, asset management, and potentially mortgages.

worth_a_read.title: Avalanche Is the Business Chain for Real-World Finance
worth_a_read.note: Delphi's thesis on Avalanche's institutional subnet architecture offers a concrete framework for evaluating which L1s can credibly host RWA issuance at scale versus those merely announcing partnerships.

worth_a_read.title: Exclusive: Nik Storonsky’s VC firm closes $500m for second fund
worth_a_read.note: The QuantumLight close is worth tracking as a proxy for whether European fintech founders with distribution advantages can translate operator credibility into LP commitments at scale in a tightening venture market.

worth_a_read.title: Regulation Crypto Assets: Structuring the exit from security status
worth_a_read.note: Messari's structural analysis of security status exit pathways provides the actual regulatory mechanics that the SEC framework announcement only gestures toward, essential for any token project's legal planning.

worth_a_read.title: The Race to Reinvent the Deposit
worth_a_read.note: The deposit reinvention research maps how stablecoin and tokenized money-market products are competing to capture the $17 trillion in US bank deposits, with direct implications for which business models survive rate normalization.

worth_a_read.title: Centrifuge Weighs Converting Tokens to Stock, Highlighting Gaps in Law
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's examination of Centrifuge's token-to-stock deliberation captures the live experiment in how crypto-native companies navigate the gap between token liquidity and equity governance, with precedent value for the entire RWA sector.

linkedin_post:
Treasury buybacks just liquidated $4 billion in crypto shorts. Not the Fed. Not a halving. The Treasury's bond operations desk.

We have spent years underwriting Bitcoin on supply scarcity and adoption curves. This week it traded like a levered Treasury duration product. Bitcoin at $77,000, Ether up 10%, nearly $2 billion in liquidations—all because sovereign debt management changed the cost of carry in traditional markets. The correlation is no longer theoretical. It is the price.

What makes this repricing durable, if anything does, is the simultaneous regulatory motion. The SEC's 'Reg Crypto' framework dropped. Trump held crypto CEOs in the Oval Office to push the Clarity Act. These are not the same cycle's false dawns. The specificity matters: security status exit pathways, token-to-equity conversions, actual rule text. Centrifuge is weighing whether tokens convert to stock. Stripe bought OpenRouter. These are corporate decisions made under the assumption that regulatory clarity is arriving, not merely hoped for.

The test for whether this regulatory premium persists is straightforward. Watch whether institutional prime brokerage actually launches in the US, not whether bills get introduced. Ripple raised $275 million for exactly this. If the pipes don't get built, the Clarity Act is just a headline and the Treasury correlation remains the only signal that matters.

We are repricing American crypto exposure for regulatory execution risk, not legislative theater. The gap between those two is where the returns live.
